title: Colombian military plane carrying more than 100 troops crashes on takeoff
byline: A Colombian military transport plane that crashed on takeoff in the south of the country was carrying more than 100 personnel, according to Vice President Francia Márquez Mina.

title: Guidelines issued to conserve fuel and energy across state sector
byline: The Commissioner General of Essential Services has issued a comprehensive set of guidelines on the prudent use of fuel and energy to all Ministry Secretaries, Provincial and District Secretaries, as well as heads of government and statutory institutions.

title: US embassy in Muscat lifts shelter in place order
byline: The US Embassy in Muscat has lifted a stay in place order for citizens in Oman’s capital.

title: At least 34 killed in Colombia military plane crash, governor says
byline: At least thirty-four people were ⁠killed on Monday when a Colombian Air Force plane carrying 125 people crashed ⁠just after takeoff, the governor of Colombia’s ⁠Putumayo department said.

title: Fairly heavy showers expected in parts of the island today
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Western, Southern, Uva and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts after 2.00 pm, today (24), the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Nishikant Dubey slams Congress for ceding Katchatheevu to Sri Lanka
byline: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MP Nishikant Dubey said on Monday that the Congress and DMK surrendered India’s maritime rights by giving Katchatheevu island to Sri Lanka.
